press_references.value: CASABOT Demonstrates the World’s First AI-Home in Live Private Session in Dubai

product_launches.description: CASABOT introduced Satellite, a compact voice-interface device enabling natural-language interaction with its BOTty AI orchestration layer for the AI-Home environment, during a live demo in Dubai.

overview_description.description:
CASABOT is redefining how people experience and interact with their spaces by delivering home and building automation as the fifth utility; as seamless and essential as electricity, water, internet, or TV.

At the core of our solution is BOTty, an AI-driven digital butler running locally on our proprietary edge-computing gateways. BOTty unifies over 3,000 third-party devices and all major protocols into a single intelligent ecosystem that works out-of-the-box, without costly panels, rewiring, or endless integrations. Instead of fragmented gadgets and apps, CASABOT creates one cohesive automation layer that learns user behavior, adapts dynamically, and delivers unparalleled convenience, comfort, and efficiency while preserving privacy through local intelligence.

product.name: CASABOT AI Home Platform
product.description: A privacy-focused home automation platform that connects devices across vendors and protocols, using local intelligence to automate lighting, climate, energy, security, and other residential or commercial functions.

product.name: HiveOS
product.description: CASABOT’s autonomous operation software for coordinating connected home devices, learning usage patterns, and automating comfort, energy, lighting, climate, and device monitoring.

product.name: BOTty
product.description: A conversational home interface that lets residents and guests control connected devices using natural language in more than 92 languages and dialects, with processing performed on-device.

product.name: CASABOT App
product.description: A mobile control application for managing connected rooms and devices, configuring permissions, supporting guest access, and providing augmented-reality views of the home.

product.name: CASABOT Remote Intelligence Dashboard
product.description: A web-based remote monitoring and management interface for viewing rooms, device status, energy use, solar generation, notifications, and property performance from anywhere.

product.name: CASABOT Partner and Deployment Services
product.description: Deployment and partnership services for developers, hotel groups, system integrators, and property operators implementing CASABOT as a managed automation amenity across residential, hospitality, and commercial properties.
